policy.entry: first fresh book while flat with no live entry pair; post one-share bid at best bid and ask at best ask
policy.fillProxy: same-market public print strictly through the limit; execution and observation must both occur after activation, before expiry, and observation must be after decision
policy.positionLimit: one active position per market; first entry proxy cancels the other entry quote
policy.exit: one passive target quote, one tick favorable to entry, with the same 3000 ms activation latency and 10000 ms quote life
policy.queueProxy: displayed quantity at the joined entry price is reported as queue-ahead context; strict-through print is still not queue-ranked execution proof
policy.primaryStress: one adverse tick per fill; a completed round trip is stressed by two ticks
policy.secondaryStress: one adverse tick total per completed round trip

limitations: Anonymous public prints do not establish aggressor side, queue position, or actual fills; all entries and exits are strict-through proxies.
Fee-free results omit venue fees, rebates, queue latency, order priority, partial fills, and cancel/replace costs.
A one-share top-of-book depth mark is executable only as a displayed-depth proxy at the cited later book; no market impact is modeled.
The primary adverse stress applies one tick against each fill, two ticks per completed round trip.

replay.rule: no split, no tuning, full fixed prefix in chronological capture order; lifecycle crossing prefix end is censored/purged
